verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a static-site export. What exists are adjacent paths: self-hosting Mintlify on your own cloud or Kubernetes (docs-18), Git-based content workflows (docs-1), and per-page Markdown export intended for AI tools (docs-9, docs-23). The local CLI is documented only for preview and build checks (docs-11), not for producing a deployable bundle. Missing for 10: a documented static-bundle export of the full rendered site, the ability to host on arbitrary static hosts without running the Mintlify platform, a whole-site export (rather than per-page Markdown), and any hands-on corroboration of portability.
